verdict.rationale: mParticle documents an integrations directory ('Connect your customer data to the leading marketing, analytics, and data warehousing solutions with just a few clicks') and shows how to connect audience outputs via the Directory, plus per-destination filtering via Consent Filters and Data Privacy Controls forwarding rules (e.g., 'Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present'). Community testimony corroborates real-world fan-out to '10 other analytics providers'. However, evidence lacks a documented catalog size/list of destinations or explicit per-destination field-mapping documentation beyond Warehouse Sync's mapping guide. Missing for 10: a documented catalog count/list of destination integrations, and detailed per-destination event/field mapping docs beyond warehouse ingestion.
